name: Turso
tagline: Turso is an edge SQLite database platform built on libSQL, a fork of SQLite, for deploying databases close to users across hundreds of locations worldwide. Developers use it to reduce latency for read-heavy applications by running the database in the same region as the request. Each tenant or user can get their own isolated database instance, making it practical for multi-tenant SaaS applications and AI apps that need per-user data storage.
